stops.name: Parque natural de Despeñaperros
stops.detail: The Natural Park of Despeñapojos is a protected natural space situated in the town of Santa Elena, to the north of Andalucía and excavated by the River Despeñapojos. It was declared a Natural Park by the Junta de Andalucía for its geological and landscape values as well as its remarkable flora and fauna and has an extension of 7649 ha.
